episode_title: Trump Rejects Iran's Ceasefire, UK Foiled Plot Near US Base, Trump Press Corps Fight
script_en: Trump Rejects Iran's Ceasefire, UK Foiled Plot Near US Base, Trump Press Corps Fight.
President Trump rejected Iran’s latest ceasefire proposal but says he remains open to talks, as questions grow over whether there is any realistic path toward ending the war.
British police arrested five men on suspicion of preparing an attack near a military base used by the U.S.
Air Force, as investigators work to determine whether a foreign government was involved.

And President Trump’s fight with the press continues even after a judge restored White House access to three banned outlets, raising questions about whether the battle is costing him the media coverage he normally seeks.
